infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Grenjo AI Tool records a voice memo so you can transcribe it into your message. Recording starts only when you tap the microphone.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Grenjo AI Tool uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo to send to a vision-capable model.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Grenjo AI Tool needs access to the photo you choose to attach to a message.
